The '''Lake Encampments''' was a [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] camp outside the city of [[Iziz/Legends|Iziz]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]] in [[3627 BBY]]. The camp was controlled by the rogue Mandalorian group [[Ash'ad]].
